name: CLOUDPT
recent: Cloudpoint 于 2026 年 11 月完成 2.658 亿股免费凭单 A 的派发与上市，每 2 股现有普通股获 1 份凭单。同期，公司公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，9 个月净利同比下降 29% 至 1030 万令吉，主要受项目延迟影响。此外，董事在 11 月有多笔股份及凭单的买卖申报。
notable: 完成 265,799,989 份免费凭单 A 的派发，每 2 股现有普通股获 1 份凭单，凭单于 2026 年 11 月 20 日上市。
公布 2026 财年第三季度业绩，9 个月净利同比下降 29% 至 1030 万令吉。
risks: 执行董事兼首席执行官 Datuk Wira Choong Wai Hoong 于 2026 年 11 月 25 日出售 2,585,968 股普通股及 1,292,984 份凭单 A。
执行董事兼销售主管 Mr Yew Choong Cheong 于 2026 年 11 月 27 日出售 4,309,946 股普通股及 2,154,973 份凭单 A。
9 个月净利同比下降 29%，主要因项目延迟。
earnings: 2026 财年第三季度（截至 6 月 30 日）营收为 4561 万令吉，环比增长 31.0%，同比微增 0.1%；净利为 414 万令吉，环比增长 109.8%，但同比下降 24.8%；净利率为 9.1%，高于上一季度的 5.7%。

recent_en: Cloudpoint completed the issuance and listing of 265.8 million free Warrants A in November 2026, on the basis of 1 warrant for every 2 existing ordinary shares. In the same period, the company reported 3QFY2026 results, with 9-month net profit down 29% year-on-year to RM10.3 million, mainly due to project deferrals. Separately, there were several director dealings in shares and warrants in November.
notable_en: Completed the bonus issue of 265,799,989 free Warrants A on the basis of 1 warrant for every 2 existing ordinary shares, with the warrants listed on 20 November 2026.
Announced 3QFY2026 results, with 9-month net profit down 29% year-on-year to RM10.3 million.
risks_en: Executive Director and CEO Datuk Wira Choong Wai Hoong disposed of 2,585,968 ordinary shares and 1,292,984 Warrants A on 25 November 2026.
Executive Director and Head of Sales Mr Yew Choong Cheong disposed of 4,309,946 ordinary shares and 2,154,973 Warrants A on 27 November 2026.
9-month net profit fell 29% year-on-year, mainly due to project deferrals.
earnings_en: For 3QFY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM45.61 million, up 31.0% QoQ and 0.1% YoY; net profit was RM4.14 million, up 109.8% QoQ but down 24.8% YoY; net margin was 9.1%, higher than 5.7% in the previous quarter.
